constraints.name: bending stiffness
constraints.text: must have transverse stiffness in the direction of opposite sense bending such that it does not deflect more than 1 cm under a 50N load if clamped at the root (k >= 50 N / 10 mm = 5 N/mm)

constraints.name: buckling
constraints.text: must have buckling strength above 500N under axial compression when under pin/pin boundary conditions

constraints.name: coiling on hub
constraints.text: coils on a 50 mm radius hub
